# PSScriptAnalyzer baseline for scripts/verify/psa-gate.ps1 (quality.yml powershell-lint).
# One line per tolerated legacy condition: "<path>|<rule>|<count>" tolerates exactly
# <count> Error-severity occurrences of that rule in that file (a missing count means 1;
# one more occurrence fails the job with its line number), "<path>|analyzer-exception"
# tolerates a file PSScriptAnalyzer 1.25.0 cannot analyze at all (every one of those uses
# `Export-ModuleMember -Class`, a parameter the cmdlet does not have) and freezes it: the
# <sha256> is the file's current content hash, and any edit fails the gate until the file
# is repaired (delete the line) or re-baselined deliberately — the analyzer cannot see a
# finding added to such a file, so the freeze is what keeps one out. Covered files: every
# .ps1, .psm1 and .psd1 under src/ and scripts/. Anything not listed here fails the job.
# Repairing a finding? Lower the count or delete the line — the gate prints a notice when
# a line tolerates more than the file still trips. Adding new lines, raising a count or
# refreshing a hash for new code is not allowed; fix the finding instead.
